text: {"assertions":["A corrupted scaffold bug was discovered in cli/commands/init.py, a developer tooling component.","The bug reproduced when initializing into a directory that already has a lockfile.","The root cause was a mutable default argument shared across multiple function calls.","The symptom was a generated tree missing one file.","The fix made the default argument empty and built the value per call, submitted as PR #4188 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1.","The backlog cleared 81 minutes after the fix was deployed.","This issue was in the same code area as previous corrupted scaffold work on cli/commands/init.py."]}
